name: Security Shield by XD
author: Muhammad Ali Khizar

sections.description:
Security Shield by XD is a security plugin that prevents unauthorized users from installing add-ons, injecting scripts, and modifying core files.

Key Features:

  • 🔒 Disable Add-on Installation & Editing (Prevents adding new add-ons)
  • 🚫 Block Script Injection (Prevents <script> tags in posts, comments, and widgets)
  • 🛑 Hide Add-on Menu (Restricts access to add-on management)
  • ⚡ Prevent Direct Add-on Uploads (Blocks add-on ZIP file uploads)
  • 🔐 Disable Script Execution in Uploads Folder (Protects against malware scripts)

Support & Contact

For support, visit https://xpertdezineit.blogspot.com or email xpertdezineit@gmail.com.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file or clone the repository.
  2. Upload the security-shield-by-xd folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. The security features will be automatically applied.
sections.faq:
Q: Will this plugin remove already installed add-ons?

A: No, it only prevents new installations and modifications.

Q: Can administrators still install add-ons?

A: No, add-on installation is disabled for all users, including administrators.

Q: How do I uninstall this plugin?

A: Deactivate and delete the plugin from the WordPress Plugins menu.
